_doc: Colour words used by the area profiles and the swatch each one means in the kit (P2-004). The swatches are look decisions for the stand-in kit, not measured: red_sandstone and red_orange_plaster are the two hex values the area sheets give (Red Fort sheet 'Buildings' #a4533b, Jantar Mantar sheet 'Buildings' #c0502d); the rest are read from the sheets' colour words. The Style Bible and the facade kit may retune a swatch; a profile only ever names the word.
